title: [BUG] Open VSX has marked vs code extension as malicious causing VS code forks using Open VSX to uninstall the extension automatically
body:
See discussion at:
https://github.com/EclipseFdn/publish-extensions/pull/945

It seems unclear if the extension that was previously published on [openvsx](https://open-vsx.org) was published by Anthropic or not.

As this has security implications for users it would be good if an up to date version of the extension is published to Open VSX as part of your release workflow.
author: erikolofsson

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body:
Hi folks. The extension is not malware. Please let me know any concerns that were reported.

Igor (igor@anthropic.com)

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body: Happy to update it (though the last published version is fine). I no longer see the namespace in my open-vsx account.
